unidades.antes: **Age of the registration:** in most cases, the domain must have been registered for at least 60 days. A new domain at Hostinger is also locked for 60 days before it can leave. The count runs from registration or the last transfer, and some extensions have their own rules.
unidades.depois: **Eligibility:** check the extension's rules, the registration or last-transfer date and transfer locks. A new domain at Hostinger is also locked for 60 days before it can leave; passing that period alone does not establish eligibility.

unidades.antes: Transferring out of Hostinger follows the same logic in reverse: 60 days of registration, unlock it in Hostinger's panel, get the code and confirm by email. A completed transfer is not refundable; see [Hostinger's refund and renewal rules](/en/reviews/is-hostinger-legit).
unidades.depois: To transfer out, check the extension's rules and current locks; obtain unlocking, a code and confirmation where the procedure requires them. A completed transfer is excluded from standard refunds. See [Hostinger's refund and renewal rules](/en/reviews/is-hostinger-legit).

unidades.antes: If you will transfer, check the registration date and the last transfer date: under 60 days, the transfer does not start.
unidades.depois: Before transferring, check the extension, dates, locks and procedures at both registrars; registration age is not the only condition.

unidades.antes: Can I change hosting without losing the domain? Yes. The domain is yours and stays in the Hostinger account; you point the DNS to the new hosting or transfer the registration later, once 60 days have passed since registration or the last transfer.
unidades.depois: Can I change hosting without losing the domain? You can keep the registration where it is and connect the new hosting through DNS, without transferring the domain. Check the website and email records before changing them.

unidades.antes: Can I transfer the domain from Hostinger to another registrar? Yes, after 60 days of registration or since the last transfer: you unlock the domain in the panel, get the authorization code and confirm by email at the new registrar. A transfer that goes through is not refunded.
unidades.depois: Can I transfer a domain from Hostinger to another registrar? It depends on extension eligibility and applicable locks. Check the procedure and, where required, unlock it, obtain the code and confirm the request. A completed transfer is excluded from standard refunds.

unidades.antes: Take the transfer only if the domain has more than 60 days of registration or since the last transfer and Hostinger's renewal is worth what you pay today.
unidades.depois: Take the transfer only if the domain meets the extension's requirements (on generic extensions, at least 60 days since registration or the last transfer, with no transfer lock) and Hostinger's renewal is worth what you pay today.

unidades.antes: Skip the transfer if the registration or last transfer is under 60 days old: it does not start.
unidades.depois: Skip the transfer if the extension or a current lock prevents it, or if eligibility has not been confirmed.

unidades.antes: Domain and hosting are two accounts: the address (the name people type) on one side, the computer where the site lives on the other. Hostinger's own page says a domain registered with it can be pointed to another hosting provider.
unidades.depois: The domain is the address people enter; hosting is the service where the website runs. You can buy them from the same company or different providers. Registering a domain in one place does not require hosting the site there: DNS can connect it to another service.

unidades.antes: **The account:** the domain belongs to the Hostinger account where it was bought. Use an email you control, not a freelancer's or an agency's. Whoever registers in someone else's name depends on that person to transfer it later.
unidades.depois: **Registration and access:** check whose name will appear on the registration and who controls the management account. Use a recovery email you control. If a person or agency does the work, agree on registration and access before buying; they are not the same thing.

unidades.antes: Use the code SONAR20 in the cart's coupon field, or come in through the link: 20% off the first period. The 20% applies to every new purchase; renewals are charged at the list price, with no discount. On a standalone domain, the code does not work.

antes: **Kaufen Sie bei Hostinger**, wenn die Website dort gehostet wird und Sie Domain, DNS und Verlängerung im selben Panel wollen; prüfen Sie die Verlängerung vor der Zahlung.

**Ich würde die Domain extern belassen und das DNS verbinden**, wenn sie bereits vorhanden ist oder ich Dienste trennen möchte. Vor einer Änderung würde ich die Einträge für Website und E-Mail prüfen.

**Ich würde die Registrierung übertragen**, nachdem Voraussetzungen, Sperren, Kosten und Auswirkungen auf das Ablaufdatum geklärt sind. Vergleichen Sie alles mit Ihren heutigen Kosten; ein enthaltenes Jahr macht nicht jeden Umzug günstiger.

unidades.antes: Domain und Hosting sind zwei Konten: auf der einen Seite die Adresse (der Name, den man eintippt), auf der anderen der Rechner, auf dem die Website liegt. Sie zahlen beides getrennt, und beides muss nicht beim selben Unternehmen liegen: Eine bei einem Unternehmen registrierte Domain kann auf das Hosting eines anderen zeigen. Die Seite von Hostinger selbst sagt, dass eine dort registrierte Domain auf einen anderen Hosting-Anbieter zeigen kann.
unidades.depois: Die Domain ist die eingegebene Adresse; Hosting ist der Dienst, auf dem die Website läuft. Sie können beides beim selben Unternehmen oder bei verschiedenen Anbietern kaufen. Die Registrierung an einem Ort verpflichtet nicht zum Hosting dort: DNS kann die Domain mit einem anderen Dienst verbinden.

unidades.antes: **Das Konto:** Die Domain gehört zu dem Hostinger-Konto, in dem sie gekauft wurde. Nutzen Sie eine E-Mail-Adresse, die Sie kontrollieren, nicht die eines Freelancers oder einer Agentur. Wer auf den Namen einer anderen Person registriert, hängt später bei einem Umzug von ihr ab.
unidades.depois: **Inhaber und Zugang:** Prüfen Sie, auf wessen Namen die Domain registriert wird und wer das Verwaltungskonto kontrolliert. Nutzen Sie eine eigene Wiederherstellungsadresse. Übernimmt eine Person oder Agentur die Arbeit, vereinbaren Sie Inhaberdaten und Zugänge vor dem Kauf; beides ist zu unterscheiden.

unidades.antes: 도메인과 호스팅은 별개의 두 계정입니다. 한쪽은 주소(사람이 입력하는 이름), 다른 쪽은 사이트가 놓이는 컴퓨터입니다. 비용도 따로 내며, 같은 회사일 필요가 없습니다. 한 회사에 등록한 도메인을 다른 회사의 호스팅에 연결할 수 있습니다. Hostinger 페이지도 Hostinger에 등록한 도메인을 다른 호스팅 업체에 연결할 수 있다고 말합니다.
unidades.depois: 도메인은 입력하는 주소이고, 호스팅은 사이트를 운영하는 서비스입니다. 같은 회사나 다른 업체에서 계약할 수 있으며 패키지도 있습니다. 한곳에 도메인을 등록했다고 그곳에서 사이트를 운영해야 하는 것은 아닙니다. DNS로 다른 서비스에 연결할 수 있습니다.

unidades.antes: **계정:** 도메인은 구매한 Hostinger 계정에 속합니다. 프리랜서나 대행사의 이메일이 아니라 본인이 관리하는 이메일을 쓰세요. 다른 사람 이름으로 등록하면 나중에 이전할 때 그 사람에게 의존하게 됩니다.
unidades.depois: **등록 명의와 접근 권한:** 누구 이름으로 등록하고 누가 관리 계정을 통제할지 확인하세요. 본인이 관리하는 복구 이메일을 사용하세요. 개인이나 대행사가 맡는 경우에도 구매 전에 명의와 접근 권한을 협의하세요. 둘은 같은 개념이 아닙니다.

unidades.antes: 장바구니의 쿠폰 입력란에 코드 SONAR20을 넣거나 이 링크로 들어가세요. 첫 기간 20% 할인입니다. 20% 할인은 모든 신규 구매에 적용되며, 갱신은 할인 없이 정가로 청구됩니다. 도메인 단독 구매에는 코드가 적용되지 않습니다.
unidades.depois: 호스팅도 필요하다면 플랜을 비교하고 SONAR20을 사용하세요. 적용 대상 신규 구매의 첫 기간은 20% 할인되며 갱신 할인은 없습니다. 도메인 단독 구매에는 적용되지 않으니 등록과 갱신 요금은 따로 비교하세요.

unidades.antes: 域名有三条路（依据 Hostinger 的页面），区别在于谁来收续费。
unidades.depois: 表格比较三种安排：在 Hostinger 新注册、在别处注册后连接、转移已有域名。不仅续费收款方不同，管理面板、流程和转移条件也要比较。

antes: **在 Hostinger 买**：网站打算放在 Hostinger，并想把域名、DNS 和续费放在同一个面板。付款前先确认续费价。
**在别处买再指向**：已经在别的注册商有域名，想把账户分开，或者那边的续费价更低。把 DNS 指向新地址只是面板里的一项设置，网站照常运行。
**转入**：只限注册满 60 天的域名，而且只在 Hostinger 的续费价比你现在付的划算时才转。转入能多出一年注册的后缀，这笔钱不算白花。
拿不准就别转：把域名指向新主机，注册留在原处。以后随时可以转，网站不会中断。
depois: **我会在 Hostinger 注册**，前提是统一面板方便管理，且续费符合预算。付款前先比较适用价格。
**我会保留外部注册并连接 DNS**，如果已经有域名，或希望分开服务。修改配置前，先检查网站与邮箱使用的记录。
**我会在核对后转移注册**，包括后缀资格、锁定、费用和到期日影响。请与当前支出整体比较；包含额外一年不代表每次转移都省钱。
如果问题只是网站放在哪里，可以先比较不转移而连接的方式。规划 DNS 变更，不要假设选择任何一条路径就保证不中断。

unidades.depois: 以我的管理习惯，确认续费与域名管理权适合后，会倾向将注册与主机放在同一面板。这是管理偏好，不是最低价格的保证。
